items.statement: Both candidate geometries are validated as complete C30H45N3O3 neutral singlets and mapped to the 30 carbon shifts.
items.expected: Two 81-atom candidates pass identity and mapping checks.

items.statement: Both named candidates receive comparable 13C predictions and normalized statistical scores.
items.expected: Both candidates have predictions, fit statistics, provenance, and probabilities summing to 1.

items.statement: The comparative carbon NMR analysis supports the 8S*,9aR*,12aR* candidate.
items.expected: 8S*,9aR*,12aR* over 8R*,9aR*,12aR*; source DP4+ carbon probabilities are 100% and 0%.
